meta.description: Unofficial design system for GNOME 51 applications using GTK 4 and libadwaita 1.10.
meta.platform: GNOME 51 · GTK 4.24 · libadwaita 1.10 · Adwaita icon theme 51 · Adwaita Sans and Adwaita Mono
meta.themes: light and dark (official Adwaita appearances), blue accent
meta.source: gnome-51-libadwaita-1.10-design-kit.zip (2026-10-30): libadwaita 1.10 semantic colour tables + 1.10 source-bundled figures (measured); ALT Penpot v2 tokens and Yokyroll Figma kit as secondary references.

tokens.name: window-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Window canvas: the background of ordinary windows, preference pages and the area around boxed lists. Pair with window-fg-color. Dark: #222226 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: window-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Primary text and symbolic icons on window-bg-color (12.2:1), card-bg-color and view-bg-color (12.6:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: view-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Content views: text editors, content lists and grids, sidebars' detail panes that show documents. Pair with view-fg-color. Dark: #1d1d20 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: view-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text and icons on view-bg-color (12.6:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: headerbar-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Header bars and toolbars in a focused (active) window. Pair with headerbar-fg-color. Dark: #2e2e32 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: headerbar-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Title, labels and icons on headerbar-bg-color (12.6:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: headerbar-border-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (same value as the foreground). Used by libadwaita only where a header bar draws a full border (e.g. high-contrast); normal header bars separate with headerbar-shade-color instead. Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: headerbar-backdrop-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Header bar background when the window is inactive (backdrop). Dark: {window-bg-color} — Documented 1.10 (@headerbar_backdrop_color = @window_bg_color, both themes): #222226.

tokens.name: headerbar-shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. 1px line under a header bar / above a bottom bar (measured: composites to #e0e0e1 under the header in header-bar.png). Composite over the surface below. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.36) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: headerbar-darker-shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Stronger header shade used where the header overlaps scrolled content (raised top bar style). Same value as headerbar-shade-color in light. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 12, 0.9) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: sidebar-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Main navigation sidebar of a split view (window's first pane). Pair with sidebar-fg-color. Dark: #2e2e32 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: sidebar-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Rows, labels and icons on sidebar-bg-color (11.2:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: sidebar-backdrop-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Sidebar background in an inactive window. Dark: #28282c (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: sidebar-border-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Edge between the sidebar and the content pane. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.36) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: sidebar-shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Shade cast by a sidebar when it overlays content (overlay split view). Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.25) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: secondary-sidebar-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Second-level navigation pane (middle column of a triple-pane layout). Pair with secondary-sidebar-fg-color. Dark: #28282c (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: secondary-sidebar-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text and icons on secondary-sidebar-bg-color (11.7:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: secondary-sidebar-backdrop-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Secondary sidebar background in an inactive window. Dark: #252529 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: secondary-sidebar-border-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Edge of the secondary sidebar. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.36) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: secondary-sidebar-shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Shade of an overlaid secondary sidebar. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.25) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: card-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Boxed lists, cards and preference groups on window-bg-color. Pair with card-fg-color. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: card-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Row titles and content on card-bg-color (12.6:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: card-shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Outline/shadow ink around cards and boxed lists; also the row separator inside a boxed list (measured: separators composite to #ededee on white = 7%). Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.36) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: dialog-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Dialogs (alert, preferences, about) — same value as the window canvas in light. Pair with dialog-fg-color. Dark: #36363a (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: dialog-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text on dialog-bg-color (12.2:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: popover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Popovers and menus. Pair with popover-fg-color. Dark: #36363a (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: popover-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Menu items and popover text on popover-bg-color (12.6:1). Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: popover-shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Shadow ink of popovers and menus. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.25) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: overview-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Tab overview background. Dark: #28282c — Documented 1.10 (documented: _colors.scss :root dark media block)

tokens.name: overview-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text on overview-bg-color. Dark: #ffffff — Documented 1.10 (documented: _colors.scss :root dark media block)

tokens.name: thumbnail-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Tab thumbnails in the tab overview. Dark: #39393d (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: thumbnail-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text on thumbnail-bg-color. Dark: #ffffff (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: active-toggle-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. The selected segment of a toggle group (raised white pill inside the group track). Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) — Documented 1.10 (documented: _colors.scss :root dark media block)

tokens.name: active-toggle-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Label/icon of the selected toggle. Dark: #ffffff — Documented 1.10 (documented: _colors.scss :root dark media block)

tokens.name: shade-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Generic shade: undershoot at scroll edges, shadows inside panes, transitions. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.25) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: dialog-dimming-color
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (floating-sheet > dimming and bottom-sheet > dimming: RGB(from var(--shade-color) r g b / calc(alpha * 2)), i.e. shade-color at twice its alpha). Measured: composites to #d7d7d9 over window-bg-color in dialog-floating.png, alert-dialog.png and dialog-bottom.png. Covers the parent window under a dialog and the content under a modal bottom sheet. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.5) — Derived from the documented formula: RGB(from var(--shade-color) r g b / calc(alpha * 2)) with the dark shade-color (25%).

tokens.name: window-outline-color
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source ($window_outline_color). The 1px inner outline of windows, dialog sheets and bottom sheets; practically invisible on the light window background. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: scrollbar-outline-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Outline around overlay scrollbar sliders so they read over any content. Dark: rgba(0, 0, 12, 0.95) (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: accent-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (blue accent). Fill of suggested-action buttons, switches when on, checked check/radio buttons, progress, selected-text background. Always with accent-fg-color. White on it is 3.8:1 — the source pair is below 4.5:1 for normal text; GNOME relies on bold labels; kept exact. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: accent-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Labels and icons on accent-bg-color. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: accent-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (blue, light, standalone). Accent as TEXT or ICON on neutral surfaces: links, accent labels, selected-row checkmarks. 6.1:1 on view/card, 5.8:1 on window. Dark: color(srgb 0.5043 0.8173 1.2188) — Documented 1.10, unclipped (*): oklab(from #3584e4 max(l, 0.85) a b) is outside sRGB; GTK mixes it unclipped and draws it clipped as #81d0ff. Written as color(srgb …) so tints match (alert-dialog-dark.png destructive response 93, 68, 70).

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. The system "Blue" accent swatch (default). Other system accents are out of scope for this stage. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: destructive-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Solid destructive fill (e.g. destructive banner/button in some contexts). With destructive-fg-color: 4.8:1. Dark: #c01c28 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: destructive-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text on destructive-bg-color. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: destructive-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (gamut-mapped *). Destructive as text/icon: the label of a destructive-action button (which is a 15% tint of this colour), destructive button rows. 6.3:1 on white, 6.1:1 on window. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471) — Documented 1.10, unclipped (*): oklab(from #c01c28 max(l, 0.85) a b) is outside sRGB; GTK mixes it unclipped and draws it clipped as #ff938c. Written as color(srgb …) so tints match (alert-dialog-dark.png destructive response 93, 68, 70).

tokens.name: success-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Success fill. White on it is only 2.3:1 — never put body text on it; kept exact. Dark: #26a269 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: success-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Foreground on success-bg-color (icons, large text only). Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: success-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (gamut-mapped *). Success as text/icon on neutral surfaces (5.3:1 on white). Always pair with a word or icon, not hue alone. Dark: #78e9ab — Documented 1.10: oklab(from #26a269 max(l, 0.85) a b), the dark --standalone-color-oklab; inside sRGB, evaluated in Chromium as for the light value.

tokens.name: warning-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Warning fill (banners, level bars). Pair with warning-fg-color. Dark: #cd9309 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: warning-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Dark text on warning-bg-color (7.3:1). Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: warning-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (gamut-mapped *). Warning as text/icon on neutral surfaces (6.1:1 on white). Dark: #ffc252 — Documented 1.10: oklab(from #cd9309 max(l, 0.85) a b), the dark --standalone-color-oklab; inside sRGB, evaluated in Chromium as for the light value.

tokens.name: error-bg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Error fill. Pair with error-fg-color. Dark: #c01c28 (documented: _colors.scss dark block).

tokens.name: error-fg-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10. Text on error-bg-color. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: error-color
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 (gamut-mapped *). Error as text/icon: invalid entry text, error labels. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471) — Documented 1.10, unclipped (*): oklab(from #c01c28 max(l, 0.85) a b) is outside sRGB; GTK mixes it unclipped and draws it clipped as #ff938c. Written as color(srgb …) so tints match (alert-dialog-dark.png destructive response 93, 68, 70).

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Derived: current foreground (0 0 6 / 80%) at --border-opacity 15%. Outlines of entries in special states, frames, linked-control dividers. 1.3:1 on white — decorative separation only; never the only cue for a control boundary. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at --border-opacity 15%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: dimmed-fg-color
tokens.usage: Derived: foreground at --dim-opacity 55% (the `dimmed` style). Subtitles, captions, placeholder text, secondary metadata. 3.2:1 on window, 3.2:1 on white — the source value is below 4.5:1; never use it for essential information. Kept exact. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at --dim-opacity 55%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: button-bg-color
tokens.usage: Derived: foreground at 10% (measured: regular buttons, linked controls and selected navigation-sidebar rows composite at alpha 20/255 in the 1.10 figures). Regular button fill; selected navigation-sidebar row; menu-item highlight composites to #ebebeb on white. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $button_color 10%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: destructive-button-bg-color
tokens.usage: Measured/derived: destructive-color at 15% (buttons-destructive-action.png fill = rgb(195 0 0) at alpha 38/255). Fill of destructive-action buttons; label is destructive-color. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471 / 0.15) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color), unclipped as GTK mixes it.

tokens.name: focus-ring-color
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source ($focus_border_color = accent-color at 50%, _colors.scss). Keyboard focus is a 2px outline in this colour. It is accent-color at 50%, not accent-bg-color. On white it composites to about 2:1, below the 3:1 non-text target; the platform value is kept and flagged. Inside status styles (error, warning, success) the stylesheet swaps accent-color, so the ring takes that colour at 50%. Dark: color(srgb 0.5043 0.8173 1.2188 / 0.5) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color), unclipped as GTK mixes it.

tokens.name: toast-bg-color
tokens.usage: Measured in toast-simple.png and in the ALT Penpot kit (toast = #505053). Toast pill background; text is white (8.0:1). Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: toast-fg-color
tokens.usage: Toast label and button icons on toast-bg-color (8.0:1). Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: button-hover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Regular button on hover. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $button_hover_color = currentColor 15% (_buttons.scss); 15% of the 80% foreground = 0.12. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $button_hover_color 15%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: button-active-bg-color
tokens.usage: Regular button pressed, and a toggled (checked) button. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $button_active_color and $button_checked_color = currentColor 30%. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $button_active_color 30%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: button-checked-hover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Toggled button on hover. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $button_checked_hover_color = currentColor 35%. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $button_checked_hover_color 35%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: button-checked-active-bg-color
tokens.usage: Toggled button pressed. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $button_checked_active_color = currentColor 40%. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $button_checked_active_color 40%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: flat-hover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Flat button on hover. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $hover_color = currentColor 7% (_colors.scss). Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $hover_color 7%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: flat-active-bg-color
tokens.usage: Flat button pressed. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $active_color = currentColor 16%. A toggled flat button uses the regular toggled fill. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $active_color 16%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: fill-hover-overlay-color
tokens.usage: Overlay over solid fills (suggested, opaque, checked check/radio, switch on) on hover. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: background-image currentColor 10% (the white label colour). Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: fill-active-overlay-color
tokens.usage: Overlay over solid fills when pressed. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: background-image RGB(0 0 6 / 20%). Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: fill-checked-overlay-color
tokens.usage: Overlay over a toggled (checked) suggested or opaque button. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: %opaque_button:checked RGB(0 0 6 / 15%); on hover 5%, pressed 30%. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

tokens.name: destructive-button-hover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Destructive-action button on hover. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $destructive_button_hover_color = currentColor (destructive-color) 20%. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471 / 0.2) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color), unclipped as GTK mixes it.

tokens.name: destructive-button-active-bg-color
tokens.usage: Destructive-action button pressed or toggled. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $destructive_button_active_color = currentColor 35%. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471 / 0.35) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color), unclipped as GTK mixes it.

tokens.name: split-separator-color
tokens.usage: Measured: the 1px divider of a flat split button, 22px tall with 6px insets (split-button.png, alpha 61/255). Raised split buttons and linked groups instead divide with button-bg-color painted over the fill. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at %flat_split_button separator: currentColor $dimmer_opacity 30%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: switch-off-bg-color
tokens.usage: Switch track when off, and check/radio ring. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $trough_color = currentColor 15% (_switch.scss, _checks.scss). The ALT Penpot kit gives the same value. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $trough_color 15%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: trough-hover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Off switch track and unchecked check/radio ring on hover; scale trough on hover. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $trough_hover_color = currentColor 20%. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $trough_hover_color 20%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: trough-active-bg-color
tokens.usage: Off switch track pressed; an unchecked check/radio pressed fills with it (no ring). Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $trough_active_color = currentColor 25%. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $trough_active_color 25%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: knob-bg-color
tokens.usage: Switch knob and scale slider. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: $slider_color = white mixed 80% with view-bg-color, which is white in the light theme. Also measured white in switch-row.png. Dark: #d2d2d2 — Derived from the documented formula: $slider_color = color-mix(white 80%, view-bg-color) with the dark view-bg #1d1d20 (rgb 209.8, 209.8, 210.4).

tokens.name: error-entry-bg-color
tokens.usage: Entry with the `error` style. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: entries fill with currentColor 10% and `.error` sets the colour to error-color, so the fill is error-color at 10%. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471 / 0.1) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color), unclipped as GTK mixes it.

tokens.name: error-ring-color
tokens.usage: Focus ring of an `error` entry or entry row. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: the focus ring uses accent-color at 50%, and `.error` redefines accent-color as error-color. Dark: color(srgb 1.2251 0.5765 0.5471 / 0.5) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color), unclipped as GTK mixes it.

tokens.name: warning-entry-bg-color
tokens.usage: Entry with the `warning` style: warning-color at 10% (Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source, same mechanism as error). Dark: rgba(255, 194, 82, 0.1) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color).

tokens.name: warning-ring-color
tokens.usage: Focus ring of a `warning` entry. Dark: rgba(255, 194, 82, 0.5) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color).

tokens.name: success-entry-bg-color
tokens.usage: Entry with the `success` style: success-color at 10% (Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source, same mechanism as error). Dark: rgba(120, 233, 171, 0.1) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color).

tokens.name: success-ring-color
tokens.usage: Focus ring of a `success` entry. Dark: rgba(120, 233, 171, 0.5) — Derived from the documented formula: the same percentage of the dark standalone colour (currentColor or accent-color).

tokens.name: row-hover-bg-color
tokens.usage: Hover fill of activatable rows in boxed lists. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: %boxed_list_row hover = currentColor 3% (_lists.scss); 3% of the 80% card foreground = 0.024. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at the boxed-list row hover, currentColor 3% (light 0.024 = 3% of the 80% foreground); currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: row-active-bg-color
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of activatable rows in boxed lists. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: %boxed_list_row active = currentColor 8%. Not button-bg-color. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at $view_active_color 8%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: expander-nested-bg-color
tokens.usage: Background of the nested rows of an expander row. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source: list.nested = card-shade-color at 50%; also measured #f6f6f6 on the white card (expander-row.png). Dark: rgba(0, 0, 6, 0.18) — Derived from the documented formula: list.nested: card-shade-color 50% (dark card-shade 36%).

tokens.name: titlebutton-bg-color
tokens.usage: The 24px circle behind window-control icons. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet (windowcontrols image = $button_color, currentColor 10%), and measured 0.08 in header-bar.png (#ebebeb on white), toolbar-view-raised.png and the adaptive split-view figures (#e6e6e7 on #fafafb). It is 8% of the 80% foreground, not 14%. Dark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) — Derived from the documented formula: currentColor at currentColor 10%; currentColor is white in dark.

tokens.name: banner-bg-color
tokens.usage: Measured: banner strip, #d4d4d7 over window-bg-color (banner.png); ALT Penpot also uses 15%. Text is window-fg-color (9.1:1). Dark: #3d3d42 — Derived from the documented formula: banner: color-mix(--banner-color #7d7d83 30%, window-bg-color) with the dark window-bg (light: #d4d4d7, measured).

tokens.name: toast-button-bg-color
tokens.usage: Measured: action button inside a toast, #626264 over toast-bg-color (toast-action.png); matches ALT Penpot. Dark: the same value (documented constant, not theme-dependent).

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: 181% of the UI font, ExtraBold. Status-page and onboarding titles. Replaces deprecated large-title. Cap height measured 19–20px in typography-titles.png.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: 136%, ExtraBold. Page titles in content, about-dialog app name.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: 136%, Bold. Section titles in content views.

styles.name: title-4
styles.usage: 118%, Bold. Smaller section titles, card titles.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The default UI text: Adwaita Sans 11pt = 14.67px at 96 dpi (GNOME default font setting; user-scalable). Control labels, row titles, single-line content.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: UI size, Bold. Window titles in header bars, preference-group titles, dialog headings, emphasised labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy for wrapping descriptions in dialogs and status pages.
styles.usage: UI size with increased line height (measured pitch 20.5px = 1.4). Wrapping explanations, dialog bodies, status-page descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Caption body text for image captions and the like.
styles.usage: 82% = 12.03px. Supporting text; never for essential instructions. Line pitch measured 17px in typography-captions.png (≈1.4; whether the role itself sets it is unverified).

styles.name: document
styles.sample: Readable main text in documents and articles.
styles.usage: Document font example value 12pt = 16px (documented as an example; follows the user's document-font setting). Main reading text, not UI descriptions. Measured pitch 22.3px.

styles.name: monospace
styles.usage: Adwaita Mono, monospace example value 11pt = 14.67px. Code, terminal output, fixed-width data.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: UI size with tabular figures (font-feature-settings: "tnum"; class .numeric in bundle.css). Counters, clocks, aligned columns.

spacing.note: GNOME publishes no universal spacing scale. Values here are the steps actually observed in libadwaita 1.10 figures or declared by the ALT Penpot v2 kit; each note says which.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: ALT Penpot `xxs`; measured as the row title–subtitle gap (row-title-gap). Hairline gaps inside compact content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: ALT Penpot `xs`; measured: navigation-sidebar rows inset 6px from the sidebar edge and 6px from each other's container (navigation-sidebar.png). Gaps between header-bar buttons, button content (icon + label).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: ALT Penpot `s`; documented as the side margin in the 1.10 adaptive boxed-list example; measured ≈12px row inner horizontal padding. Default container padding, gap between a row's suffix widgets.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Proposal (the docs' 6/12/18/24 mockup rhythm). Spacing between a group heading block and loosely related content. Not a measured libadwaita value.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: ALT Penpot `m`; documented as vertical margin and group gap in the 1.10 adaptive boxed-list example. Gap between preference groups; page top/bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: ALT Penpot `l`. Large separation on status pages and wide layouts. Unverified natively.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Measured in 1.10 figures (buttons-raised/suggested: corner profile of a 9px radius). Buttons, entries, toggle groups, linked groups, navigation-sidebar rows. ALT Penpot says 6px and the Yokyroll Figma kit 6px — both outdated for 1.10.

tokens.name: radius-entry
tokens.usage: ALT Penpot `entry.radius` 9; visually equal to buttons in linked-controls.png. Text entries, search entries, spin buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Measured: boxed lists, cards and standalone rows (boxed-lists.png, cards.png, action-row.png). ALT Penpot `row.radius` 12. Outer corners of a boxed list only — inner rows are square.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Documented 1.10 --window-radius default; changes with window state (0 when maximized/tiled). Window corners only — not a component radius.

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source ($popover_radius = $menu_radius 9px + 6). Also measured ≈15px in popover-menu-list.png. Popovers and menus.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source ($dialog_radius = $button_radius 9px + 6, floating AdwDialog sheet). Floating dialogs such as preferences and about dialogs. Alert dialogs use radius-alert (18px).

tokens.name: radius-alert
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source ($alert_radius 18px, _message-dialog.scss). Alert dialogs only. This is the 18–20px corner measured in alert-dialog.png and given by ALT Penpot `dialog.radius`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Fully rounded: pill buttons, circular buttons, switches, toasts, toggle-group round style.

shadow.note: Card, header bar, popover and window shadows are fitted by rendering candidates and comparing alpha profiles with the libadwaita 1.10 figures (header-bar.png, boxed-lists.png, window.png, popover-menu-list.png). Knob, slider and toast shadows are documented from the libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Boxed lists, cards, standalone rows on window-bg-color. Verified: matches the halo around boxed-lists.png within 1–2/255 on every side. Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-headerbar
tokens.usage: Header bar with its 1px headerbar-shade-color bottom line drawn inside its 47px height, plus the soft fade below. Verified within 1/255 against header-bar.png. Whether a flat AdwToolbarView top bar shows the fade before content scrolls is unverified. Dark: Derived: the inset line is the dark headerbar-shade-color (36%); the fade below is the same token at 50%, as in light.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus (popover contents). Fitted to popover-menu-list.png and compared with the source value in _popovers.scss (0 0 0 1px RGB(0 0 0 / 5%), 0 1px 5px 1px RGB(0 0 0 / 9%), 0 2px 14px 3px RGB(0 0 0 / 5%)): against the figure the fitted value differs by 0.96 alpha levels on average, the source value by 1.07, so the fitted value is kept. Approximate. Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source (switch > slider box-shadow 0 2px 4px RGB(0 0 6 / 20%)); transparent when disabled. Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-slider
tokens.usage: Scale slider. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source (1px ring at RGB(0 0 6 / 10%) plus the knob shadow). Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source (toast box-shadow, _misc.scss). Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-toolbar-top
tokens.usage: ToolbarView top bar in the raised style. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (_toolbars.scss: headerbar-shade-color at 50%, 1px line plus 2px/4px blur, drawn below the bar). Dark: Derived: _toolbars.scss headerbar-shade-color at 50% with the dark shade (36%).

tokens.name: shadow-toolbar-bottom
tokens.usage: ToolbarView bottom bar in the raised style, mirrored above the bar. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source. Dark: Derived: as the top bar, mirrored.

tokens.name: shadow-toolbar-border-top
tokens.usage: ToolbarView top bar in the raised-border style: a 1px headerbar-darker-shade-color line. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source. Dark: Derived: the dark headerbar-darker-shade-color.

tokens.name: shadow-toolbar-border-bottom
tokens.usage: ToolbarView bottom bar in the raised-border style. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source. Dark: Derived: the dark headerbar-darker-shade-color.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (_dialogs.scss floating-sheet > sheet, _bottom-sheet.scss bottom-sheet > sheet). Floating dialogs, dialogs presented as bottom sheets and AdwBottomSheet. Compared with dialog-floating.png, dialog-bottom.png and bottom-sheet.png (see evidence.md). Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-bottom-bar
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (_bottom-sheet.scss sheet.bottom-bar: shade-color at 75% for the 1px ring, then shade-color and two wider soft layers). An AdwBottomSheet showing its bottom bar. Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Floating windows and floating dialogs. Fitted to window.png within ~10/255 near the edge, ±2 beyond 8px; the figure is symmetric — a native window may offset it downward (unverified). Dark: the same value (the source shadows are constant RGB values in both themes).

tokens.usage: Documented. Foreground at this opacity = border-color.

tokens.name: dim-opacity
tokens.usage: Documented. Foreground at this opacity = dimmed text (dimmed-fg-color).

tokens.name: toast-height

tokens.name: button-padding-x
tokens.usage: Measured: horizontal padding of text-only buttons (buttons-raised.png, label inset 17–18px incl. side bearing).

tokens.name: image-button-padding-x
tokens.usage: Measured: horizontal padding of buttons with an icon and a label, menu buttons with an arrow, and entries (button-content.png, buttons-raised.png menu button, linked-controls.png entry).

tokens.name: pill-padding-x
tokens.usage: Measured: pill button horizontal padding (buttons-pill.png, 138px wide around a 72px label).

tokens.name: button-content-gap
tokens.usage: Measured: gap between icon and label, and between a label and the menu arrow (button-content.png, buttons-raised.png).

tokens.name: split-arrow-width
tokens.usage: Measured: the arrow part of a split button (16px icon + 4px each side) (buttons-raised.png, split-button.png).

tokens.name: toggle-height
tokens.usage: Measured: a toggle inside a toggle-group track (3px track padding, 3px between toggles) (toggle-group.png). Flat toggle groups use 34px toggles.

tokens.name: check-size
tokens.usage: Check and radio indicator. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source (14px icon + 3px padding each side, check radius 6px, radio fully round, 2px ring at currentColor 15%). Agrees with ALT Penpot and Yokyroll (20×20).

tokens.name: knob-size
tokens.usage: Measured: switch knob (switch-row.png, 3px inset in the 46×26 track). Also the scale slider (Penpot 20px).

tokens.name: scale-trough-height
tokens.usage: Scale trough thickness. Third-party (ALT Penpot); unverified.

tokens.name: row-padding-start
tokens.usage: Measured: row titles and prefix content start 14px from the list edge — verified by overlaying rendered rows on boxed-lists.png and action-row.png (title ink matches to the pixel).

tokens.name: row-padding-end
tokens.usage: Measured: switch, combo arrow, expander arrow and suffix icon buttons all end 14px from the row edge (switch-row, combo-row, expander-row, action-row figures).

tokens.name: row-title-gap
tokens.usage: Measured ±1px: gap between a row title and its subtitle (action-row.png), and between an entry-row title and its text (entry-row.png).

tokens.name: button-row-height
tokens.usage: Measured: AdwButtonRow height (button-rows.png, button-row-*-action.png) — shorter than the 54px reference rows.

tokens.name: row-spin-button-size
tokens.usage: Measured: circular decrease/increase buttons in a spin row, 10px apart (spin-row.png). Standalone SpinButton arrows are 34px.

tokens.name: group-heading-gap
tokens.usage: Measured: space between a preferences-group heading block and its boxed list (6px margin + 6px spacing in adw-preferences-group). Title and description are 6px apart (box.labels border-spacing, documented); the title label is 19px and a one-line description 21px, as GTK rounds Pango extents (fitted).

tokens.name: status-icon-size
tokens.usage: Measured: status-page icon (status-page.png); 96px in the compact style (status-page-compact.png).

tokens.name: progress-height
tokens.usage: Progress bar thickness. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 stylesheet source (progressbar trough and progress min-height 8px, minimum width 150px). The ALT Penpot kit gives the same value.

tokens.name: osd-progress-height
tokens.usage: Measured: OSD progress bar along the bottom edge of a header bar (osd-progress-bar.png).

tokens.name: headerbar-inline-height
tokens.usage: A HeaderBar inside a ToolbarView is flat and 46px (6px padding around 34px controls); the bar style supplies any background or shadow. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (%headerbar-flat). With more than one stacked bar it shrinks to 40px (3px padding).

tokens.name: sidebar-item-height
tokens.usage: AdwSidebar row: 36px box + 3px padding top and bottom, 2px between rows, 6px from the sidebar edges, 14px content inset, 12px icon–label gap, 9px radius. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (_sidebars.scss); measured 42px with a 44px pitch in sidebar.png and adaptive-navigation-sidebar-wide.png.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-min
tokens.usage: Split-view sidebar minimum width, in sp (scales with Large Text). Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (min-sidebar-width 180, unit sp, in adw-navigation-split-view.c and adw-overlay-split-view.c).

tokens.name: sidebar-width-max
tokens.usage: Split-view sidebar maximum width, in sp. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (max-sidebar-width 280). A collapsed OverlaySplitView uses this width when it fits.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-fraction
tokens.usage: Preferred sidebar share of the split view's width, clamped between sidebar-width-min and sidebar-width-max. Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (sidebar-width-fraction 0.25). Measured: 200px in an 800px window (adaptive-navigation-sidebar-wide.png).

tokens.name: breakpoint-split-view
tokens.usage: Collapse threshold used by the official split-view examples: max-width 400sp (adaptive-layouts.md, adw-navigation-split-view.c, adw-overlay-split-view.c, adw-sidebar.c). sp = px × text scale, so it is 500px with Large Text. An example value, not a GNOME-wide rule: choose the width at which your content stops fitting.

tokens.name: breakpoint-view-switcher
tokens.usage: Threshold in the official view-switcher example: max-width 550sp (adaptive-layouts.md). The docs say to adjust it to the number and length of view titles.

tokens.name: view-switcher-button-min-wide
tokens.usage: Minimum natural width of a wide ViewSwitcher button (MIN_NAT_BUTTON_WIDTH_WIDE, adw-view-switcher-button.c); buttons are homogeneous, 3px apart, 34px tall, and shrink below this with ellipsized labels. Measured: 120×34 in view-switcher.png.

tokens.name: view-switcher-button-min-narrow
tokens.usage: Minimum natural width of a narrow ViewSwitcher button (MIN_NAT_BUTTON_WIDTH_NARROW). Narrow buttons are 40px tall (4px + 16px icon + 18px label + 2px) with −3px margins. Measured: 100×40 in view-switcher-bar.png; 80px each when four share a 360px window.

tokens.name: view-switcher-bar-height
tokens.usage: Standalone ViewSwitcherBar: 7px + 34px + 6px with headerbar-bg-color and a 1px headerbar-shade-color top line (_view-switcher.scss, _toolbars.scss). Inline in a ToolbarView it is transparent and 46px (6px top padding).

tokens.name: indicator-dot-size
tokens.usage: needs-attention dot on view switcher icons (AdwIndicatorBin), accent-color, with a 2px ring cut out of the icon. ViewSwitcherSidebar uses an 8px dot. Documented: _view-switcher.scss, _sidebars.scss.

tokens.name: indicator-badge-height
tokens.usage: badge-number pill on view switcher icons: 0.6rem bold white label, 0 4px padding, currentColor 40% (accent-bg-color with needs-attention), centred on the icon's top-end corner; 999+ above 999. ViewSwitcherSidebar uses a 1.6em pill. Documented: adw-indicator-bin.c, _view-switcher.scss, _sidebars.scss.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Documented HIG symbolic canvas 16×16. Default rendered size of symbolic icons in buttons, rows and header bars.

tokens.name: clamp-max-width
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (adw-clamp.c, maximum-size default 600). Maximum readable width of preference pages and forms.

tokens.name: clamp-tightening-threshold
tokens.usage: Documented: libadwaita 1.10.0 source (adw-clamp.c, tightening-threshold default 400). Below this width the clamp gives the child the full width; between it and the maximum size the extra width is eased out.

tokens.name: window-min-desktop
tokens.usage: Documented HIG target: desktop apps should work at 1024×600.

tokens.name: window-min-mobile
tokens.usage: Documented HIG target: phone-capable apps scale down to 360×294.
